# Making your own gear cutters {#sec-cutters}

Stock involute cutters cover every gear in this machine but one. The six-tooth cone gear sits below the smallest cutter range, so you make its cutter, DT6-FORM1, a tool ground to the form on its own drawing sheet. The replica uses standard 48DP 20° teeth for exactly this reason; the reconstruction's earlier pitch, DP 49.82, matched no cutter anyone sells (`cad/docs/gear-standard.md`).
